column1: I can't believe they got away with stealing my car! I'm so angry I could punch a wall!
Please help me, I'm scared. I think someone is following me and I don't know what to do.
If I ever see that guy again, I swear I'll make him pay for what he did to my family.
I'm at my wit's end with these constant break-ins. The police aren't doing anything to help!
I feel so helpless and anxious all the time since the robbery. I can't sleep at night anymore.
That's it! I've had enough of this neighborhood. The crime here is out of control!
I'm going to find whoever vandalized my store and teach them a lesson they'll never forget.
Every time I hear a noise at night, I panic thinking it's another home invasion. This stress is unbearable.
The court let that criminal walk free? This justice system is a joke! I'm absolutely furious!
I'm desperate and don't know what else to do. These threats are ruining my life, and I'm terrified to leave my house.
